title: Public PDF to JSON with Page-Cited RAG Chunks

publicDataOnly.title: Public non-personal permitted input only
publicDataOnly.description: Keep checked to confirm the documents are public, permitted to process, and contain no personal data. Runs with this unchecked are rejected (not charged). This is a policy acknowledgement, not automated PII detection.

pdfUrls.title: PDF URLs
pdfUrls.description: Public http(s) URLs of text PDFs (up to 5 in total together with pasted documents). Each PDF is fetched by the Actor: at most 1 MiB, ports 80/443 only, no credentials in the URL, redirects limited to 3, 20-second timeout; URLs resolving to private/internal addresses are refused. Failed fetches are listed in the run summary and are not charged. A PDF must have 1-20 pages and extractable text (no OCR).

chunkSize.title: Chunk size for URL PDFs
chunkSize.description: Characters per chunk for fetched PDFs (250-4000, default 1500). Pasted documents set their own chunkSize inside the document object.

chunkOverlap.title: Chunk overlap for URL PDFs
chunkOverlap.description: Characters shared between consecutive chunks of fetched PDFs (0-1000, must be less than chunkSize, default 150).

documents.title: Pasted documents (optional, up to 5 in total with URLs)
documents.description: Optional. Content you paste directly. Counts toward the 1-5 items per run together with the URL list. 1 MiB decoded PDF, 1-20 pages, 200,000 text characters, chunkSize 250-4,000 and chunkOverlap 0-1,000 (less than chunkSize). Encrypted/malformed PDFs and image-only scans are rejected. No OCR, tables, images, embeddings or metadata/author extraction. Pricing: $0.008 per successful document + $0.00005/run start. XML entries/PDF chunks are nested, not separately charged. Total input under 8 MB.
